descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Location: Vilnius (Artery Business Center, Konstitucijos pr. 18B). We love the office energy, so we’re looking for someone to join us 5 days a week! Duration: 3-6 months Type: Paid Internship (Full-time), 925 EUR gross/month As our Business Support Intern, you aren’t just handling tasks—you’re the heartbeat of our Vilnius office. Working side-by-side with our Site Business Partner, you’ll contribute to making our workplace “great place to work”. You’ll experience how global corporations, operating based on Agile principles, actually function. Your engagement will span from event planning to data governance, all while networking with our Pharma and Diagnostics colleagues in Lithuania and Baltics. The Mission By the time you wrap up your internship, you’ll have learnt about document archiving, understood the personal data compliance and GDPR governance in Lithuania, hosted several epic events, and mastered the art of creating an office environment people actually want to show up for. What You’ll Be Doing:
• Owning front-of-house operations and keeping the daily office flow smooth.
• Curating the pantry & stationery—ensuring the coffee is flowing and the supplies are stocked.
• Being the main point of contact for incoming calls and general emails inbox.
• Logistics wizardry: Managing couriers and making sure every parcel finds its home.
• Being the office guru for parking and general "how-to" questions. What Will You Learn:
• Organizing internal events and what’s related to operational excellence around event execution (from idea generation to invoice management).
• Implementing and upgrading data governance and archiving frameworks.
• Running wellness initiatives like the Children Walk across the Baltic states. Is This You?
• You’re a student (Bachelor’s or Master’s) in Business, Marketing, Economics, HR, or similar field.
• You’ve got strong interpersonal skills and an eye for detail.
• You enjoy interacting with people and have a positive attitude.
• You can work independently but also enjoy collaboration with colleagues from cross-functional areas.
• Fluent English is non-negotiable. Ready to level up? Join us and let’s make an impact together! Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
